milestone: Alpha 1.73 durable shared direct-trade decision storage
status: prepared, not published or connected to the trade coordinator
changes: Store one immutable server-authored settlement-or-cancellation decision per stable trade ID. Duplicate preparation retains the first exact plan, timestamp and terminal outcome; changed plans conflict and another pending participant reservation reports busy.

Force primary majority reads and journaled majority writes independently of URI preferences. Unknown insert/completion acknowledgements remain unknown and require the same-ID read; no compensating grant or cancellation is performed.

Require actual durable character receipts for BOTH participants before the compare-and-set completion. Caller-provided snapshots or boolean save flags cannot acknowledge a decision. Terminal replay does not rewrite participants.

Schema18 creates a unique partial multikey index reserving both pending accounts, plus a bounded recovery index. Reader-only older binaries refuse startup on this schema because byte preservation alone is not coordinated trade recovery. No character/currency/item backfill or terminal-ID expiry.

Add an isolated-Mongo CI fixture for actual two-account index reservation, partial-save rejection, receipt verification after a new repository/client, immutable terminal replay and both participants' pending queries.

limits: No new local Mongo process, native browser, sockets, long soak, production-data mutation, push or deployment. Live remains accepted Alpha1.70.1 fa414f0b288e8ee014d5ce72f7affdca485e1c7f.

This storage API does not persist current RAM escrow, coordinate the two live account locks, apply/claim deliveries, fence startup/login or retire old cleanup behavior. Those integrations remain required before publishing1.73.

Completion relies on the coordinator holding BOTH sorted account work locks and fencing later saves throughout both durable receipt reads. The storage API alone is not cross-account transactional runtime safety.

Schema18 is prepared only. Do not remove its marker to start an older server or claim rollback by byte preservation. Future downgrade requires a compatible recovery writer or an explicit proven recovery strategy.
The full valuable-operation ledger, recovery growth/retention and exact-source release/public checks remain open. No whole-economy, capacity or milestone-completion claim.
